about.title: About us
about.intro: Bajarchini is a Bengali-first digital market guide. Our goal is to help every shopper in Bangladesh buy good products at the local bajar with confidence.
about.mission1: Create simple guides for identifying fish, meat, vegetables, fruit and everyday essentials.
about.mission2: Explain the difference between good and poor quality, and the warning signs to look for.
about.mission3: Visit one reference market every month, observe prices in person and publish them.
about.method: Each month our representative visits the reference market, checks several shops and records the minimum and maximum price for each product. The data is reviewed and published with the observation date. If a month is not observed, it stays empty — we never copy the previous month's price forward.
about.limits: Our prices are not live or official prices and do not represent all of Bangladesh. Visual quality checks cannot guarantee food safety.

footer.description: A Bengali-first digital market guide for shoppers in Bangladesh — product identification, quality checks and monthly market prices in one place.
footer.disclaimer: Prices on Bajarchini are approximate prices observed at one reference market, not live market prices. Quality guidance is general information only.
footer.notEcommerce: Bajarchini is not an online shop — we do not sell any products.
